tasks.title: Lecture #29
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a neuroscience class.
tasks.transcript: Man: (M-Br) Let’s talk a little about language acquisition, which is the process by which humans learn to understand and use language. There are two main types of language acquisition: first language acquisition and second language acquisition. First language acquisition occurs naturally and with relative ease during early childhood, through interaction with family and the surrounding environment. Children are able to pick up their native language quickly due to their innate linguistic capabilities, a concept supported by the linguist Noam Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar. Universal Grammar suggests that the ability to acquire language is innate to humans and that all human languages share a common underlying structure. Second language acquisition, on the other hand, often requires more conscious effort and formal education and typically happens later in life. Several factors influence the ease and success of second language acquisition, including exposure to the language, age, and motivation. Motivation, in particular, plays a crucial role—highly motivated individuals are more likely to engage actively with the language and persist in their learning efforts. Age is also significant; according to the critical period hypothesis, there is an optimal window in early childhood during which language acquisition occurs most easily. After this period, acquiring a new language can be more challenging. Understanding these processes helps educators and linguists develop effective teaching methods and language learning tools.

questions.stem: How is the talk mainly organized?

options.A: It contrasts children’s innate linguistic capabilities with those of adults.
options.B: It lists the principles of Noam Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar.
options.C: It describes the differences between two methods of teaching language.
options.D: It discusses the two main types of language acquisition.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这段讲话主要是如何组织的？ 定位原文： There are two main types of language acquisition: first language acquisition and second language acquisition. First language acquisition occurs naturally... Second language acquisition, on the other hand, often requires more conscious effort... 选项分析： A. It contrasts children’s innate linguistic capabilities with those of adults（它对比了儿童与成人的先天语言能力）。讲话提到儿童的语言先天能力，但未与成人进行对比，所以A选项错误。 B. It lists the principles of Noam Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar（它列出了诺姆·乔姆斯基普遍语法理论的原则）。讲话仅提及该理论作为支持观点，并未列出其原则，所以B选项错误。 C. It describes the differences between two methods of teaching language（它描述了两种语言教学方法的差异）。讲话讨论的是语言习得类型，而非教学方法，所以C选项错误。 D. It discusses the two main types of language acquisition（它讨论了两种主要的语言习得类型）。讲话围绕第一语言习得和第二语言习得展开，介绍了各自的特点及影响因素，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention Noam Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar?

options.A: To highlight the importance of formal education in language learning
options.B: To explain why children are able to pick up their native language quickly
options.C: To describe how some languages are more complex than others
options.D: To provide background on the critical period hypothesis

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：演讲者为什么提到诺姆·乔姆斯基的普遍语法理论？ 定位原文： Children are able to pick up their native language quickly due to their innate linguistic capabilities, a concept supported by the linguist Noam Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar. 选项分析： A. To highlight the importance of formal education in language learning（为了强调正规教育在语言学习中的重要性）。讲话指出第一语言习得是自然的，不依赖正规教育，所以A选项错误。 B. To explain why children are able to pick up their native language quickly（为了解释为什么儿童能够快速学会母语）。讲话明确指出儿童能够快速掌握母语是由于其先天语言能力，而乔姆斯基的普遍语法理论支持这一概念，因此B选项正确。 C. To describe how some languages are more complex than others（为了描述某些语言为何比其他语言更复杂）。讲话未讨论语言复杂性，所以C选项错误。 D. To provide background on the critical period hypothesis（为了提供关键期假说的背景）。普遍语法理论与关键期假说是两个不同的概念，讲话未用前者为后者提供背景，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about motivation and language acquisition?

options.A: Higher motivation makes it easier for a person to acquire a second language.
options.B: Motivation becomes less important to language acquisition as a person ages.
options.C: Children with increased exposure to a second language are more motivated to learn it.
options.D: Formal education does not motivate people to acquire a second language.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：演讲者关于动机和语言习得说了什么？ 定位原文： Motivation, in particular, plays a crucial role—highly motivated individuals are more likely to engage actively with the language and persist in their learning efforts. 选项分析： A. Higher motivation makes it easier for a person to acquire a second language（更高的动机使人更容易习得第二语言）。讲话明确指出高度动机的个体更可能积极参与语言学习并坚持努力，因此A选项正确。 B. Motivation becomes less important to language acquisition as a person ages（随着年龄增长，动机对语言习得的重要性降低）。讲话未讨论动机重要性随年龄的变化，所以B选项错误。 C. Children with increased exposure to a second language are more motivated to learn it（接触第二语言越多的儿童学习动机越强）。讲话未讨论暴露量与动机的关系，所以C选项错误。 D. Formal education does not motivate people to acquire a second language（正规教育不能激励人们习得第二语言）。讲话未讨论正规教育与动机的关系，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is suggested by the critical period hypothesis?

options.A: People with innate linguistic capabilities acquire language easily.
options.B: There is an optimal window in early childhood for language acquisition.
options.C: A longer period of language exposure supports better learning.
options.D: Second language acquisition occurs most easily in early adulthood.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据演讲者，关键期假说提出了什么观点？ 定位原文： Age is also significant; according to the critical period hypothesis, there is an optimal window in early childhood during which language acquisition occurs most easily. 选项分析： A. People with innate linguistic capabilities acquire language easily（具有先天语言能力的人容易习得语言）。这是普遍语法理论的观点，而非关键期假说，所以A选项错误。 B. There is an optimal window in early childhood for language acquisition（在幼儿时期存在一个语言习得的最佳窗口）。讲话明确指出关键期假说认为在幼儿时期存在一个语言习得最易发生的最佳窗口，因此B选项正确。 C. A longer period of language exposure supports better learning（更长时间的语言暴露有助于更好的学习）。关键期假说强调的是年龄窗口，而非暴露时长，所以C选项错误。 D. Second language acquisition occurs most easily in early adulthood（第二语言习得在成年早期最容易发生）。关键期假说认为最佳窗口在幼儿时期，而非成年早期，所以D选项错误。
